question: Pointing to Kiran, Rohan says, “She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather.” How is Kiran related to Rohan?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Pointing to Kiran, Rohan says, “She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather.” So, there have two possible diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd5c8289398b3a9ecec979ac3fae7c29a9b2139f7ac50e422f40eb1bb06e2975.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8689cd1ef2ca4505fa22435ac0a2eb62db7373a70db93fad1e09be8ff26fc65.png] 

 

But cousin is not present in options.

So,The only son of Rohan's grandfather is Rohan's father.

Daughter of Rohan's father is sister of Rohan.

Hence, ‘**Sister**’ is the correct answer.
